title: Golgra - All 3 Locations & How to Beat Her
description: Golgra appears in three places in Expedition 33 - Gestral Village, the Dark Gestral Arena and the Sacred River. Where to find her and how to win.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: 3 encounters — Gestral Village · Dark Gestral Arena · Sacred River

facts.label: Missable
facts.value: Yes — one encounter is permanently missable

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Golgra is the Chief of the Gestrals and one of the toughest optional fights in Expedition 33. She appears in three separate encounters, and one of them is a permanent missable.

sections.title: The Three Golgra Encounters
sections.content:
1. Gestral Village (first meeting)

You meet her early in Act 1 while passing through Gestral Village. Fighting her here is not recommended - her attacks and health pool are far beyond what an early party can handle. Treat it as an endgame encounter to come back to with better gear.

2. Dark Gestral Arena (Act 3)

A floating arena southeast of White Tree, reachable once Esquie can fly. Golgra is the fourth and final challenge here.

Important: the Gestrals in the giant pots will ask you to fight Golgra immediately after you defeat the Chromatic Robust Sakapatate. You must accept the request right then - if you decline, you lose the chance to fight her in this arena.

3. Sacred River (Monoco's relationship quest)

She also appears at the Sacred River as part of Monoco's relationship sidequest. The Sacred River is a short distance north of Monoco's Station.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toNone

No elemental weakness and no resistances. There is no build trick here - this is a pure damage and execution fight.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
Golgra's specific drop list is not documented in the sources we could verify.

She is the final challenge of the Dark Gestral Arena and a relationship-quest opponent at the Sacred River, so clearing her is primarily about progression rather than a unique reward.

sections.title: How to Beat Golgra
sections.content:
• Bring Maelle. Her single-target damage output is the most reliable answer to a boss with no exploitable element
  • Do not attempt the Gestral Village fight early - it is tuned for a late-game party
  • Watch the accept prompt in the Dark Gestral Arena. Accept immediately after Chromatic Robust Sakapatate or the encounter is gone for good
  • With no weaknesses and no absorb, counterattacks are unusually valuable - they ignore the elemental question entirely
